council-of-ministers-legal-terms.note: Catalogued as សទ្ទានុក្រមពាក្យច្បាប់ ផ្នែករដ្ឋប្បវេណី និងនីតិវិធីរដ្ឋប្បវេណី, Office of the Council of Ministers, 2007, in the Ministry of Education's Sala Digital library. The download is not byte-identical (3,289,452 vs 2,813,445 bytes) but all 64 pages render pixel-identical and every page's extracted text matches exactly, so the files differ only in PDF container encoding. The National Council of Khmer Language sat within the Office of the Council of Ministers at the time, so catalogues crediting either body are both right; `issuing_body` here follows the Sala Digital record.
